import { MeshBasicNodeMaterial } from 'three/webgpu';
import { uv, mix, color, texture, uniform } from 'three/tsl';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const { Group, Mesh, PlaneGeometry, Euler } = ctx.THREE;

  const group = new Group();

  // Active resource tracker for perfect cleanup
  const disposables = [];
  const timelines = [];

  // Color Palette
  const colors = {
    ink: '#16161d',
    paper: '#e8ecf2',
    accent: '#ff2a38',
    surface: '#0b0b10'
  };

  // 1. BACKDROP PLANE (Prevent FLAT_VOID, create premium depth stage)
  const bgGeom = new PlaneGeometry(8, 7);
  disposables.push(bgGeom);

  const bgMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({ depthWrite: false });
  disposables.push(bgMat);

  // Vertical gradient background matching the spec colors
  const bgUv = uv();
  bgMat.colorNode = mix(color(colors.surface), color(colors.ink), bgUv.y);

  const bgMesh = new Mesh(bgGeom, bgMat);
  bgMesh.position.set(0, 0, -2.5);
  group.add(bgMesh);

  // 2. HERO CARD (Textured Plane / Sprite Billboarding Mode)
  // Sized directly matching the atlas aspect ratio (512x320 -> 1.6)
  const cardWidth = 3.2;
  const cardHeight = 2.0;

  const cardGeom = new PlaneGeometry(cardWidth, cardHeight);
  disposables.push(cardGeom);

  const cardMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({
    transparent: true,
    opacity: 0.98,
    depthWrite: true
  });
  disposables.push(cardMat);

  // Base luxury color gradient with a signature signal red accent border on the left
  const cardUv = uv();
  const cardBaseGradient = mix(color(colors.surface), color(colors.ink), cardUv.y);
  const leftBorder = cardUv.x.step(0.015);
  const cardDesignNode = mix(color(colors.accent), cardBaseGradient, leftBorder);

  cardMat.colorNode = cardDesignNode;

  const cardMesh = new Mesh(cardGeom, cardMat);
  
  // Custom camera-facing billboarding tracking logic
  cardMesh.onBeforeRender = (renderer, scene, camera) => {
    cardMesh.quaternion.copy(camera.quaternion);
  };
  group.add(cardMesh);

  // 3. RADIAL CONTACT SHADOW (Prevents floating artifact)
  const shadowGeom = new PlaneGeometry(cardWidth * 1.2, 0.35);
  disposables.push(shadowGeom);

  const shadowMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({
    transparent: true,
    opacity: 0.45,
    colorNode: color('#000000')
  });
  disposables.push(shadowMat);

  const shadowMesh = new Mesh(shadowGeom, shadowMat);
  shadowMesh.position.set(0, -cardHeight / 2 - 0.08, -0.05);
  
  // Keep the shadow locked to card's rotation but flattened on y axis
  shadowMesh.onBeforeRender = (renderer, scene, camera) => {
    const camEuler = new Euler().setFromQuaternion(camera.quaternion, 'YXZ');
    shadowMesh.rotation.set(-Math.PI * 0.42, camEuler.y, 0);
  };
  group.add(shadowMesh);

  // Texture loading with high performance TSL blending
  const imageUrl = config.imageUrl || '/prism-assets/chrome/ceramic-grain.map.png';
  ctx.textureLoader.loadTexture(imageUrl)
    .then((tex) => {
      tex.colorSpace = ctx.THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      tex.wrapS = ctx.THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      tex.wrapT = ctx.THREE.RepeatWrapping;

      const textureNode = texture(tex, cardUv);
      cardMat.colorNode = mix(
        cardDesignNode,
        textureNode.rgb,
        uniform(0.16) // Discrete and high-quality 16% grain overlay
      );
      cardMat.needsUpdate = true;
    })
    .catch((err) => {
      console.warn('Ceramic texture load failed, fallback gradient active.', err);
    });

  // GSAP Entrance Animations (Premium rise-in and settle)
  const introTimeline = gsap.timeline();
  timelines.push(introTimeline);

  cardMesh.position.y += 0.45;
  cardMesh.scale.set(0.9, 0.9, 0.9);

  introTimeline.to(cardMesh.position, {
    y: 0,
    duration: 0.8,
    ease: 'power3.out'
  });
  introTimeline.to(cardMesh.scale, {
    x: 1,
    y: 1,
    z: 1,
    duration: 0.9,
    ease: 'power4.out'
  }, '<');

  // Subtle breathing idle animation (No multi-axis fast spin)
  const idleTimeline = gsap.timeline({ repeat: -1, yoyo: true });
  timelines.push(idleTimeline);
  idleTimeline.to(cardMesh.position, {
    y: 0.035,
    duration: 3.0,
    ease: 'sine.inOut'
  });

  // Guaranteed clean unmounting and disposal APIs
  group.userData = {
    handlers: {},
    cleanup() {
      // Clear out all active GSAP animations
      timelines.forEach((tl) => tl.kill());
      // Deep release geometry and material memory allocations
      disposables.forEach((item) => {
        if (typeof item.dispose === 'function') {
          item.dispose();
        }
      });
    }
  };

  return group;
}
